title: eval-score
description: One scored dimension of an eval run (04-wololo-evals SPEC Section 3.2). trial_index null/absent = aggregate row over all trials; an integer = per-trial raw sample (including the k=5 raw judge samples). Score rows are additive to a run, never overwritten, so a run's full scoring history is always reconstructable. Every row is pinned to the suite_version and rubric_version content hashes that produced it (SPEC Section 9). judge is the model id of the LLM judge that produced this score, absent when rule-based.
